content: Move the heat-bed up a couple of inches by manually turning the lead screws. Then you can get to it from under the heat bed.
luckily I had a pair of forceps to hold the nut in place instead of with this tool

I’m going to put this early in these steps so it helps with the top back ones that are really difficulty. It works with all of them. Put the bottom screw in just enough to hold the puck to the machine. Use a small Allen key that can go through the side hole and the m3nN nut. When holding assembly tool put index finger over the m3nN nut hole as you position it. Push the Allen key in and out trying to find the hole and the proper position. Hold in place while you secure the puck with a screw replacing the Allen key.
An electric screwdriver is what made that one possible for me.

Put your index finger into the triangle hole and point it to the edge, this worked for me. 
I wish the tool had a magnet slot for it to hold into place on its own once positioned.
That was by far the worst part
